title: Pirros VS. Content Management Systems
summary: Pirros outperforms traditional CMS software like Unifi by offering a dynamic database, user-friendly search engine, and meticulous control, providing architects with a superior solution for efficient and standardized detail management.
body_markdown:
## Overview


Introducing Pirros, a practical solution for simplifying detail management. Unlike traditional content management systems (CMS), Pirros offers a dynamic database that transforms how architects and professionals access and utilize project details. With our user-friendly search engine, finding any detailing condition is quick and efficient, saving you time.


What makes Pirros unique is our emphasis on meticulous control, providing reference-only details and permissions to ensure a secure environment for non-vetted project details. Leveraging data from past projects, Pirros streamlines the vetting process for new details, enhancing efficiency and maintaining standardization.


In contrast, CMS software like Unifi is limited to managing standard details. Pirros addresses the challenges of relying solely on past projects, offering a centralized solution for architects to confidently manage their detailing needs.
